long_biography.plain_text:
Buying Nabisco's African businesses gave Vivian Imerman an option to acquire Del Monte Royal Foods. He exercised it with Anglo American, took chief-executive responsibility and reshaped an underperforming international food group before listing the business in Singapore and later exiting his interest.

His next large operating test was Whyte & Mackay. Imerman reorganised production and distribution, expanded the Scotch-whisky company and sold it in 2007, sharing part of the proceeds with employees through bonuses. As executive chairman of Vasari, he has continued the same acquisition-and-turnaround approach in consumer brands, particularly food and alcoholic beverages.

As executive chairman of Vasari, he has continued the same acquisition-and-turnaround approach in consumer brands, particularly food and alcoholic beverages.
